name: Streamline Approximation via Iterative B-spline Fitting
definition: A method to compute a B-spline curve γ(u) approximating a set of samples X, avoiding the oscillations (wriggles) introduced by interpolation or least-squares approximation, which are problematic for generating tubular geometry and ambient occlusion.
summary: Streamline Approximation via Iterative B-spline Fitting reduces data by generating smooth B-spline curves that avoid the oscillations of least-squares approximation, ensuring cleaner tubular geometry for volume rendering.
